flags.message: Forward-signal disclosure: web search (2026-08-20) for the companion state case Baxter v. Philadelphia Board of Elections (Pa.) showed it argued September 2025 with no decision yet. That pending state-constitutional challenge is the BIO's lead vehicle/mootness argument and materially shaped this forecast (it is the main reason P(grant) is 0.55 rather than higher). Nothing about this petition's own disposition was sought or surfaced; none can exist yet post-CVSG.
